title: §3/§4 — unfinished member blocks convergence; gates emit real disposition
goal: Suppress cycle convergence when any iteration member's disposition satisfies disposition_unfinished (§4/A), route router-terminated reason through router_reason_disposition in spec-coverage/spec-correspondence/review-report instead of hardcoding 'complete' (§3/B), and amend ADR-063 to Accepted on #2187's vocabulary (§C).

steps.description: Write the red tests for §4/A (must fail at merge-base). New integration test with a design_verify_cycle fixture: T1 — design returns disposition:timed_out + structurally valid design.md + design-gate pass + spec-coverage covered → the cycle does NOT converge that iteration (red: it converges today). T2 — same fixture with disposition:complete → cycle DOES converge (green baseline). T3 — at max_iterations with the last iteration member unfinished → cycle takes the exhaustion path, not complete.

Engine fix for §4/A: in cycle-orchestrator.sh, after the build-specific suppression block at line 2613, add a second suppression that fires when converged==0 AND _iter_did_not_finish==1. Emit cycle.member_unfinished.suppressed_convergence with iter/disposition context. Update the comment at lines 2570-2573 which currently says '_iter_did_not_finish is Consumed ONLY by the reason-aware exhaustion halt' to reflect it is now also used for convergence suppression. Keyed entirely on the disposition word via disposition_unfinished — no stage names.

Write the red tests for §3/B (must fail at merge-base, before plugin fixes). In tests/unit/spec-coverage-test.sh, add SPEC-9: when route_to_model exits non-zero (simulated timeout), the result has disposition:timed_out, NOT 'complete'. In tests/unit/spec-correspondence-test.sh, add a parallel case: router timeout yields disposition from router_reason_disposition, not 'complete'. In tests/unit/review-report-v2-contract-test.sh, add a case: when a lens rc file holds a non-zero router exit code, the stage's result disposition is the router_reason_disposition of that code, not 'complete'.

Fix spec-coverage for §3/B. In spec_coverage_run (plugin.sh ~line 178), replace '|| true' with a local _scv_rc capture using a temp file written by the subprocess. Add an optional disposition parameter to _scv_write (default 'complete'). In the 'no parseable verdict' branch (~lines 192-195), when _scv_rc is non-zero, classify via _router_rc_classify + router_reason_disposition and pass the disposition word to _scv_write instead of the hardcoded default.

Fix spec-correspondence for §3/B. In _sc_call (~line 114), accept an optional third argument — a path to an rc-sink file — and write the raw router exit code to it when the router call exits non-zero (replace '|| true' with rc capture + conditional write). Add an optional disposition parameter to _sc_write_result (default 'complete'). In spec_correspondence_run, pass a temp file to _sc_call for the batch call, read back the rc, classify via _router_rc_classify + router_reason_disposition, and forward the disposition to _sc_write_result when rc is non-zero.

Fix review-report for §3/B. In the failed-lens loop (~lines 167-171), track the first non-zero rc across all failed lenses. After the loop, when _rr_failed_lenses is non-empty and the tracked rc is non-zero, classify it via _router_rc_classify + router_reason_disposition to get the disposition word; use that instead of the hardcoded 'complete' at ~line 174.

Amend ADR-063 (§C). Change Status to 'Accepted, amended 2026-10-02 by #2032'. In §3, replace every instance of 'exhausted' with 'timed_out'/'out_of_turns' and note the classifier is router_reason_disposition (scripts/lib/router-rc-classify.sh:259). In §4, strike the 'exhausted → escalate' half (retry + router-side timeout growth already replace it per ADR-029 and route.sh:872) while keeping and updating the gate-fail-closed rule to reflect it is now implemented. In §1, replace 'One helper renders the budget block' with a note that the invariant is satisfied by per-stage _<stage>_budget_guidance helpers each reading the enforcing values. Add dated back-pointer: 'Amended onto #2187's vocabulary; see #2187 for retirement of exhausted and escalate'.

notes:
ORDERING: steps 1 and 3 (red tests) must be committed before their corresponding implementation steps (2 and 4-6) per TDD discipline — the PR body must state the assertion and how it failed at the merge-base. ADR amendment (step 7) can land last after all tests are green.

CYCLE-ORCHESTRATOR INSERTION POINT: The new generic suppression block goes between line 2613 (end of build-specific block) and line 2615 (start of #1265 no-committed-changes guard). The variable _iter_did_not_finish is already in scope, computed at lines 2574-2581. The check mirrors the build suppression pattern: if [[ "$converged" -eq 0 ]] && [[ "$_iter_did_not_finish" -eq 1 ]]; then converged=1. The build-specific check at 2608 fires first; if _build_disposition is unfinished, both checks would fire — harmless since converged=1 after the first. The new block catches the non-build-member case (e.g. design timed_out). Must NOT interfere with the empty_diff resting point: the empty_diff path sets all members' dispositions to 'complete', so disposition_unfinished returns false for all, _iter_did_not_finish stays 0, and the empty_diff case passes through correctly.

SPEC-CORRESPONDENCE RC CAPTURE: _sc_call is invoked via command substitution (its output is captured as $_raw); shell semantics prevent a nameref from crossing the subshell boundary. A temp file written inside the subshell and read by the parent is the correct mechanism. The temp file must be cleaned up after the rc is read.

REVIEW-REPORT WORST-RC: The .rc files store raw router exit codes. 'First non-zero found' is sufficient to satisfy §3 — all non-zero codes classify to some unfinished disposition word via router_reason_disposition. A more principled ordering is possible but out of scope.

DESIGN-GATE NOT IN SCOPE: The issue notes design-gate always writes disposition:complete. This is intentional — design-gate is a tool stage that did complete; it is design's timed_out disposition that should suppress convergence, and the engine fix (step 2) handles that without touching design-gate.

BLOCKED-ON VERIFICATION: The issue is blocked on #1835 (plan) and #1838 (impact). This plan does NOT touch plan or impact; it only fixes spec-coverage, spec-correspondence, and review-report (already on v2). The ADR amendment documents the per-stage helper pattern but does not add new budget-block helpers to the remaining stages — those are #2222's scope.

FIXTURE APPROACH FOR STEP 1: The test must drive the cycle-orchestrator directly (not a full pipeline run). Reference patterns: tests/integration/cycle-multi-iter-cumulative-test.sh and tests/integration/cycle-on-max-pipeline-continues-test.sh for constructing verdicts_blob fixtures with stubbed member dispositions without a live LLM.

SCOPE FILES CONFIRMED: core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh, docs/adr/ADR-063-budget-disclosure-and-partial-output.md, plugins/agent/review-report/plugin.sh, plugins/agent/spec-correspondence/plugin.sh, plugins/agent/spec-coverage/plugin.sh, tests/integration/cycle-member-unfinished-no-convergence-test.sh (new), tests/unit/review-report-v2-contract-test.sh, tests/unit/spec-correspondence-test.sh, tests/unit/spec-coverage-test.sh — all verified to exist or be net-new.
